topPRs.title: feat(cloud): wire bounded backup admission caller
topPRs.author: standujar
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- add the production Worker caller boundary for V3 periodic-backup admission on the existing minute trigger
- require unforgeable in-process scheduler provenance and a deterministic scheduled-time owner identity
- keep the caller explicitly OFF in root, staging, and production unless the exact binding value is `"1"`
- compose only the existing enrollment, claim, reservation, and defer database authorities
- bound each invocation to 64 enrollment turns, 4,096 claim turns, 800 claimed items, and a scheduler-anchored 45-second deadline
- drain every acquired batch through reservation or exact defer accounting before propagating failure, deadline, or cancellation
- report only this durable caller's non-2xx/throws as failed Cron events, call `noRetry()` after all siblings settle, and preserve legacy fanout behavior
- retain the legacy six-hour backup caller until separately authorized staging evidence proves replacement

## Safety boundary

This slice does not capture a sandbox, call a backup provider, discover/create capacity, autoscale, deploy, enable staging/production, remove the legacy caller, or make a Ready/merge transition.

## Verification

- Bun 1.3.14 targeted matrix: 38 tests, 227 assertions, 0 failures
- deterministic proof: 10,640 items across 64 shards and four priorities drain in fourteen minute ticks with no duplicate reservation or starvation
- route provenance/auth/disabled-first/error semantics, Cron event-level retry suppression, fanout POST coverage, Wrangler schedule parity, and scheduled identity coverage
- codegen: 705 mounted routes, 127 shards, 3 intentional skips, 0 unconverted; generated router and shard-key hashes revalidated
- cloud-shared and cloud-api typechecks; Wrangler production bundle dry-run only
- `verify:cloud`: 84/84 on exact head `814cb55a57864179df78bfb7b2aea7a0467b06b3`
- two independent exact-SHA reviews: no P0-P3 findings

The caller does not change the PostgreSQL repository authorities. Their real 10,640-row evidence remains on the parent reservation stack; a fresh local reacquisition attempt for this slice stopped before assertions because the ephemeral PostgreSQL harness did not become ready.

Advances #24407. Stacked on #29785.

topPRs.title: fix(core,sql): complete bounded large-content paging
topPRs.author: hermesagent270-commits
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Completes the remaining acceptance work for #25140 on top of #29754:

- adds an explicit authorized, caller-bounded legacy-content reindex contract
- locks and size-checks the parent before fetching legacy source bytes, with a 16 MiB hard ceiling
- atomically publishes the bounded parent descriptor and immutable segment generation
- threads page and reindex reads through the requester's PostgreSQL entity context so restrictive RLS and pushed-down access predicates compose
- exposes the reindex operation through the runtime
- adds a 10 MiB PGlite restart/reassembly proof and a real PostgreSQL/RLS authorization proof

This is intended as a completion/replacement for #29754, whose current body explicitly defers the legacy migration and PostgreSQL/RLS acceptance items.

## Verified evidence

- `bun run --cwd packages/core typecheck`
- `bun run --cwd plugins/plugin-sql typecheck`
- `bun run --cwd plugins/plugin-sql build`
- PGlite real integration: 7/7 passed, including bounded 10 MiB legacy reindex, exact reassembly, and restart
- PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector real RLS integration: 1/1 passed, including wrong-room denial and per-page reauthorization
- core paging/segmentation tests: 16/16 passed
- root `bun run verify`: 375/375 turbo tasks plus all repository audits passed

Closes #25140

topPRs.title: feat(agent): secure exact restore candidate filesystem (#20726)
topPRs.author: standujar
topPRs.body:
## Scope

Adds the private Agent filesystem boundary needed to stage an exact restore-v3 candidate for #20726. The implementation is split into authority/control, durable JSON, payload, and tree proof/cleanup modules behind one small facade.

This PR does not materialize PGlite/character/media/state/vault components, boot a candidate, publish activation, or route traffic.

## Guarantees

- production is Linux-only and descriptor-bound through `/proc/self/fd`; every traversed directory is opened `O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW`
- one persistent kernel `flock` remains bound to the attempt-root inode across pathname rename
- payload owner/receipt sidecars allow exact crash and lost-response replay without persisting the owner token itself
- canonical durable JSON uses no-replace link publication plus parent-directory fsync and exact crash repair
- payloads reject symlinks, hardlinks, overflow, replaced inodes, and other owners; provider-owned buffers/descriptors are disposed on late abort
- canonical JSON rejects sparse arrays, accessors, symbol keys, and undeclared properties
- cleanup preflights the bounded tree and uses an internal cleanup deadline
- non-Linux pathname emulation is available only with the explicit test-only flag under `NODE_ENV=test`; production fails closed

## Proof

- Linux container with real `/proc` and kernel flock: 15/15, 59 assertions
- macOS explicit test-only emulation: 15/15, 59 assertions
- Agent TypeScript: green
- Biome: green
- git diff --check: green
- no residual test container or flock/sleep helper

## Explicit platform limit

`flock` is advisory for cooperative participants. Node does not expose the full `openat2`/`unlinkat`/`linkat(AT_EMPTY_PATH)` set used to eliminate every last-component race against a deliberately non-cooperative same-UID process. Ancestors remain descriptor-bound/no-follow and final identities are revalidated; deployments must keep the staging root private to this Agent authority.

Draft only. Keep stacked on #29958; do not mark Ready or merge without explicit authorization.
